2.en: The new bus route benefits people in this area.
2.zh: 新公交线路让这一带的居民受益。

6.en: There is no extra fee for online payments.
6.zh: 网上付款不收额外费用。

15.en: It was awkward to ask for my money back.
15.zh: 开口要回我的钱有些尴尬。

16.en: The view from the top of the tower filled us with awe.
16.zh: 塔顶的景色让我们心生敬畏。

18.en: The shop sells computers at retail prices.
18.zh: 这家商店按零售价出售电脑。

19.en: The app tailors the lessons to your level.
19.zh: 这个应用会根据你的水平定制课程。

23.en: A language barrier can make travel difficult.
23.zh: 语言障碍会让旅行变得困难。

26.en: I found a bargain on a used laptop.
26.zh: 我淘到了一台便宜的二手笔记本电脑。

29.en: This free plan is deficient in storage space.
29.zh: 这个免费套餐的存储空间不足。

31.en: She is proficient in three programming languages.

34.en: The guide gives only a superficial overview of the topic.
34.zh: 这份指南只对主题作了表面的概述。

58.en: From my perspective, the update is easy to use.
58.zh: 在我看来，这次更新很容易使用。

60.en: The statement gives the meeting time as three o'clock.
60.zh: 声明中说会议时间是三点。

62.en: I had only a vague notion of how the device worked.
62.zh: 我对这台设备的工作原理只有模糊的概念。

68.en: She bought an antique radio at the market.
68.zh: 她在集市上买了一台古董收音机。
